# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI from [banner-workflow.api.json](banner-workflow.api.json): 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 902114, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture. It was picked from four seeds; an earlier prompt with a newspaper on the desk was dropped because every take printed invented headline text.

Prompt:

> a brass magnifying glass resting on an open scientific journal showing a bar chart, a pie chart and a scatter plot with error bars, a stack of folded papers, on a wooden desk by a sunny window, a small evergreen sprig in a vase, a cup of tea, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, the page print is soft and illegible, no headlines, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark
